key_insight: RoboVIP uses Visual Identity Prompting to synthesize temporally- and multi-view-consistent manipulation videos that preserve robot appearance and motion, enabling effective data augmentation for robot policy learning.
problem_solved: Scarcity of large-scale, diverse, temporally- and multi-view-consistent robot manipulation data—existing image-level diffusion augmentations change scenes but fail to preserve robot identity, cross-view coherence, and realistic motion needed for policy training.
method: Visual Identity Prompting (VIP): condition generation on robot appearance/pose to keep the agent visually consistent across augmentations.
Multi-view video generation pipeline: a diffusion/temporal model that enforces temporal continuity and cross-view consistency to produce synchronized camera streams.
Augment-and-train: integrate synthesized multi-view videos into the robot policy training set and evaluate improvements on manipulation tasks.
impact: Provides a scalable way to create realistic, multi-view training data that improves generalization and sample efficiency of manipulation policies, reducing costly real-world data collection and enabling broader benchmarking across environments.
